items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: Now the last job I played up with Armstrong... I did it more when I was with Louis Armstrong

ctx.x: Somebody once said, if you take a match, and go along real slow, and you can see the light flicker, and go along, and you go fast with the light, and you just look like one streak. That's right. Of course you run down and scale fast, and one road in there, it isn't there, it's too fast, your ear doesn't catch it. It's the same thing as ear doesn't. And then back to your lip again, if you do have any trouble with your lips, is there anything you can recommend, like certain ointments, or?

I never did use no kind of salve, or no ointment, or nothing. I never had any. I never did have to use anything. Because I don't, I think it wouldn't do any good, you know, it's a matter of time. Yeah. Usually if you just, your lip is so, and just, you know, give it a chance, you don't have to practice as much, it'll finally get better, the first thing you can do to be alright. You just do it. To be frank with you, Armstrong is the first guy I see never use salve. I never see nobody else use salve.

I was wondering, in regard to your, you say you were mostly self-taught I guess, I know your father and all your brothers and all played a lot too, so it's really like having a lot of teachers around everybody you heard. But did you ever have many formal lessons, or actually take up a book to read and all that, if there was any time, when did you?

items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: The interviewee mentions Louis Armstrong only in response to interviewer's questions comparing styles or asking about associates ('like Louis does', 'play somewhat like Louis' style', 'He worked with Louis'). The interviewee never claims to have met, played with, or known Louis Armstrong personally.

ctx.x: Did he ever cock his valves a little long?
His half valves halfway down, you know, with sliding glissandles like Louis does.
No, I think Punch Miller used to be a shock on that half cock valve.
